scope: Custody events affecting access to Hodgson-associated paper objects after research use. Material identity and custody identity are kept separate.

formula: paper_object_history = production_history × supply_history × stock_history × research_operation × post_use_custody_history

source_control_rules: Keep material identity separate from custody identity.
Auction lot number is not a stable object identifier across later splitting or resale.
Old published shelfmark and current catalogue shelfmark/status must both be retained when they conflict.
A public provenance gap is not proof of physical loss.
Do not generalize one lot's private-custody route to neighbouring lots.
Collection-level support descriptions require sheet-level material verification.
